newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIAN OVERNIGHT RATES EASE, LAT FIRMS VS DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: LATVIAN OVERNIGHT RATES EASE, LAT FIRMS VS DOLLAR.

text.p: Latvian overnight rates eased as bank liquidity stays high while the lat firmed against the dollar, money market dealers said on Tuesday.
Overnight lending rates have fallen to 1.90/2.90 percent from around 3.0 percent and some two million lats were lent overnight on Monday, dealers said.
"The liquidity situation in the banks looks good right now," said one dealer.

Meanwhile, the lat climbed against the dollar after the U.S. currency slipped against the mark on Monday. The dollar later rebounded but dealers said Monday's dollar dip was still feeding through to the Latvian market.
The lat was trading at 0.5680/0.5688 range after opening Monday at around 0.5705.
Dealers said that around three to four million dollars had been traded so far in lat/dollar activity.
